review.decision: Preserve existing document and policy expectations while extending the native oracle runner
review.notes: Fresh review before the first P edit of scripts/test_design_test.py and check-native-documents.py. ND-003 retains both production document oracles, assertion-enabled compilation and failure propagation. Already reviewed SCENE-MIG-001 adds the production notification payload/queue and completion Foundation oracles to the same runner and CI invocation. Verify all four compile/execute pairs and each compiler/process failure; no UIKit, scene lifecycle or device approval follows from Foundation execution. Stable TD/ND/CP/DG case objects remain unchanged. Existing f5e48cd4 review for shared TD-006/CI edits stays in history; this review does not rewrite that chronology.
